title: Sources: Moonshot AI is deactivating its Cayman holding company and moving investors' stakes to its primary operating entity in China to pave the way for an IPO (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: Moonshot AI is deactivating its Cayman holding company and moving investors' stakes to its primary operating entity in China to pave the way for an IPO — Chinese artificial-intelligence startup Moonshot AI is wrapping up a corporate restructuring that would pave the way for an initial public offering.
